rationale: Shiza's hands-on experience building humanoid robot subsystems at 1X and her current work at Haptile on hardware-AI integration complements Sharon's focus on production-ready AI agent infrastructure for biotech and healthtech. While Shiza brings deep expertise in computer vision and embodied AI systems, Sharon's partner-level work on agentic AI tooling represents the infrastructure layer that could unlock new capabilities for robotics and autonomous systems—a natural technical and business fit for exploring how agent frameworks apply to hardware contexts.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Sharon — you're both building at the frontier of applied AI (humanoid robotics + agentic infrastructure), and there's likely real synergy between Haptile's hardware-AI work and TheAgentic.Ai's production agent stack.
